---
title: Venus in the scales
description: Venus turns back through Scorpio and into Libra this autumn. A short guide to what the retrograde has traditionally been taken to mean, and how to sit with it.
date: 2026-10-06
status: approved
---
From 3 October to 13 November 2026 Venus appears to move backwards against the stars, beginning in Scorpio and ending the retrograde in Libra, one of the two signs it traditionally rules.

In the old symbolism Venus is the planet of affection, beauty and the things we value. Astrologers have long read its retrograde periods as a time for looking again rather than starting anew: revisiting an old friendship, rereading a letter, or noticing which objects in a room you would keep if you could keep only a few.

None of this is a forecast. It is an invitation to reflect, and the weeks of a retrograde are a pleasant excuse to slow down and take stock.

For reflection: what do you value now that you did not value a year ago?
